title: Regional 8(a) Janitorial Services
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.NAVFAC.NAVFAC ATLANTIC CMD.NAVFAC WASHINGTON.NAVFACSYSCOM WASHINGTON
detail_text: This acquisition will result in the award of a performance based, Firm-Fixed Price (FFP), Indefinite-Delivery/Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contract for services comprising Recurring Work and Non-Recurring Work for custodial services in the Naval Washington District (NDW) at sites within 100-mile radius of Washington, DC. The Contractor shall provide all labor, management, supervision, tools, materials and equipment, facilities, transportation, incidental engineering and other items necessary to provide the services outlined in the Performance Work Statement (PWS). AMENDMENT 0004 The purpose of this amendment is to extend the Proposal Due date from Monday, March 3, 2026 to Monday, March 9, 2026, 2:00 PM. All other terms and conditions remain unchanged. AMENDMENT 0003 The purpose of this amendment is to correct the response date in PIEE from Feb 19, 2026 to March 2, 2026. All other terms and conditions remain unchanged.
